# Købe eller sælge? Bliv bedre til investeringsbeslutninger

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode on making investment decisions under uncertainty, with decision adviser Anne Gissing covering stress-testing your own thesis, opportunity cost, second-level thinking, cognitive biases and exit plans. The market segment covered the Swedish election, which puts listed school operators at risk; AI doomsday comments weighing on electrification and green-energy stocks; Brent oil above $107 after the Iran war and a Saudi pipeline closure; and hot US core inflation that may force a Fed hike. The panel's stock-game positions lean towards oil, tankers and US energy.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TRMD-A — Torm | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michel bought Torm in the stock game as a bet on rising oil prices and Middle East tension.

#### Reasoning

Guest strategist Michel Nørgaard is positioned for rising oil prices: Brent is at about $107.76, up 10% last week, and a Saudi pipeline has closed after an attack. Tankers benefit from supply disruption. This is a fictional stock-game position, so conviction is tactical.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices reverse
- if the Middle East conflict de-escalates

> *"jeg har købt Torma, jeg har også købt to, hvad hedder det, olieaktier. Så jeg har helt klart gået ind i det bet, der hedder, at olieprisen er stigende."*

---

### 🟢 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michel bought Mærsk in the stock game as part of his oil and Middle East tension bet.

#### Reasoning

Michel's tactical game position ties shipping to Middle East disruption, where rerouting and higher rates help. The stock was among the morning's top gainers. This is a fictional stock-game trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Middle East tensions ease
- if freight rates fall

> *"Så jo, jeg har både købt Abemøller Mærsk"*

---

### 🟢 CVX — Chevron | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought Chevron in the stock game after his algorithm signalled US oil stocks.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars Persson's algorithm flagged US oil stocks as oil rallied on the Iran war. He admits he came in late and would normally not buy US stocks. This is a fictional game position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if his algorithm turns
- if oil prices fall

> *"Og så har jeg købt to olieaktier, Chevron og Marathon Petroleum"*

---

### 🟢 MPC — Marathon Petroleum | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought it in the stock game as an oil play.

#### Reasoning

Same algorithm-driven oil momentum trade as Chevron; this is a fictional game position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall
- if the algorithm signal reverses

> *"Og så har jeg købt to olieaktier, Chevron og Marathon Petroleum"*

---

### 🟢 WFC — Wells Fargo | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought it after decent key figures; expects US banks to hold up.

#### Reasoning

Lars reads the latest figures as acceptable and expects US banks to perform reasonably in the near term. This is a fictional game position with limited stated conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US bank earnings disappoint
- if Fed hikes hurt credit quality

> *"købte jeg i fredags Wells Fargo ovenpå, at nøgletallen jo ikke så helt skidt ud"*

---

### 🟠 HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars, a technical analyst, says wait: the trend has not turned and the bottom is not found, despite fans of the company.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson rejects the fundamental enthusiasm until the price trend confirms a reversal. He would enter only once the downtrend turns and momentum builds.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the downtrend continues to new lows

> *"Jeg kan jo godt gå rundt og sige, at Husqvarna er verdens fedeste selskab... vent nu lidt, vent nu lidt, fordi trenden er ikke vendt"*

---

### 🟡 TYRES — Nokian Tyres | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought at 10 and a listener bought around 6; the share is now trending upwards.

#### Reasoning

Lars notes that the stock has bottomed and is in an uptrend, so momentum supports staying in. No explicit new buy call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the uptrend breaks

> *"tusind tak for Nokian Tyres, fordi han fik den til 6 et eller andet, jeg købte den til 10... og nu er aktien opadgående"*

---

### 🟠 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Risk to Swedish for-profit school operators if the red bloc wins the election.

#### Reasoning

Lars flags political risk: the Social Democrats oppose profit from running schools, which could hit listed school operators. He says the panel must see how the shares move.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a red-bloc government moves to limit school profits

> *"det kan jo egentlig komme til at gå ud over sådan nogle som skole, de børsnoterede skoleselskaber"*

---
